results.title: Fake Instagram Profiles To AI Deepfakes: 5 Online Scams Gen Z Should Not Ignore
results.description: The internet has become integral to daily life, especially for Gen Z, who often encounter online scams. A McAfee report highlights that over one-third of Gen Z adults in the US lost money to scams last year.

results.title: Himanta Biswa Sarma’s AI ‘Gangnam Style’ dance video with Assam ministers viral
results.description: An AI-generated clip featuring Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma and ministers Pijush Hazarika and Jayanta Mallabaruah dancing to PSY’s hit song has attracted millions of views on Instagram.
